evidence_quotes: Watervergunning. Keur Amstel, Gooi en Vecht. Weigering blijft in stand.
rationale: The Dutch administrative decision directly adjudicates an appeal against the refusal ('Weigering') of a water permit ('Watervergunning') under the regional water authority ordinance ('Keur Amstel, Gooi en Vecht'). Under the protocol, decisions concerning a Watervergunning and waterschap Keur are substantively WATER under both labels and best classified under regulatory_permit (with waterboard_governance context), with no household utility connection or informal settlement issue.
